data_fields.name: parents_per_tree_link
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 link per parent name per tree (a repeat is an error)

data_fields.name: self_inherit
data_fields.donor_constant: an entry starts with its own name in the inherited set (self-link is an error)

best_idea: A mod unit is a short row that says which base it inherits, changes only the keys it names, and removes a named key with a minus prefix, with a missing parent, a repeated parent, a self-inherit, or a removal that matches nothing all failing the load with the file and line.
decision_why: Keep the inherits and minus-removal format and its errors for legend and zone rows, because a designer can write this boss as the base legend with two changes; add a warning when a patch overwrites a stat; a layer must never write a reward count (one-ledger rule); reject the Lua sandbox (rows stay data-only).
acceptance: A server test loads a base legend row set, then a legend row with Inherits legend_base and -Ability bleed, and asserts the ability list equals the base list without bleed; a row that inherits the same parent twice, or removes a key the parent lacks, fails the load and the error names the file and line.
